newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - SONAT Inc upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SONAT Inc upgraded to buy.

text.p: PaineWebber said Monday it raised its rating on the shares of SONAT Inc to buy from attractive.
-- Analyst Ronald Barone said in a research note he was upgrading the shares because of the weak stock price.

-- SONAT said the J.E. Ryon No. 1 Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef trend exploratory test in the Tri-Cities area of Henderson County, Texas, failed to encounter a reef and is being evaluated for possible completion in shallower formations.
-- Barone said he would trim his 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates to account for lower production levels and higher-than-expected exploration expense, but that the story remained intact.
-- "At current levels, the stock is trading at only a slight premium to its peers, despite the significant portion of its earnings derived from exploration and production activities," Barone said.
